purpose: Training inventory only; these names were read from user-provided Chess Clash equipment screenshots.
warning: Names are not visual training samples. Do not mark a skin as AI-supported until in-match piece crops are labeled and included in validation.
training_requirements: Capture each set during an actual match, not only from the equipment-card preview.
Label each visible board square with one of the 13 classes.
Include multiple board themes, lighting/highlight states, scales, and both board orientations.
Split validation by piece set so unseen skins are tested honestly.
